prompt: Name one of Europe's ten smallest sovereign countries by area.
label: Final Dig
note: Definition used: sovereign states conventionally counted as European by area rankings, including Vatican City (via the Holy See) and Kosovo (partial recognition — see its own fact). Cyprus is geographically part of Asia Minor but is politically and culturally European (EU member since 2004, Council of Europe), the convention standard area-ranking sources use for it. Area figures and ranking verified via current sources, Oct 2026: Vatican City, Monaco, San Marino, Liechtenstein, Malta, Andorra, Luxembourg, Cyprus, Kosovo, Montenegro.

answers.name: Vatican City
answers.fact: At 0.49 square kilometers, the smallest sovereign state on Earth, not just in Europe.

answers.name: Monaco
answers.fact: Fits inside New York's Central Park almost twice over, yet hosts a Formula 1 Grand Prix through its own streets.

answers.name: San Marino
answers.fact: Claims to be the world's oldest surviving republic, founded by tradition in the year 301.

answers.name: Liechtenstein
answers.fact: One of only two doubly landlocked countries on Earth — bordered solely by Switzerland and Austria, both themselves landlocked.

answers.name: Malta
answers.fact: A former British colony; English remains an official language alongside Maltese.

answers.name: Andorra
answers.fact: Has no standing army, and its head of state is shared jointly by France's president and a Spanish bishop.

answers.name: Luxembourg
answers.fact: The only remaining sovereign grand duchy in the world.

answers.name: Cyprus
answers.fact: Geographically part of Asia Minor, but politically and culturally counted as European — an EU member since 2004.

answers.name: Montenegro
answers.fact: Independence from Serbia was decided by a 2006 referendum that passed just over the required margin.

answers.name: Kosovo
answers.fact: Recognized by over 100 UN member states, but not by Serbia, Russia, or China, among others.

extras.name: Slovenia
extras.fact: A small Alpine country, but well outside Europe's smallest ten by area.

extras.name: North Macedonia
extras.fact: Renamed from simply 'Macedonia' in 2019 to settle a decades-long dispute with Greece.

extras.name: Albania
extras.fact: Sealed off from most outside contact for decades under Cold War-era isolationist rule.

extras.name: Moldova
extras.fact: Wedged between Romania and Ukraine, and among Europe's poorest countries by some measures.

extras.name: Belgium
extras.fact: Small by reputation, but several times the area of every country actually on this round's list.

extras.name: Netherlands
extras.fact: A notable share of its land sits below sea level, held back by dikes — not the same thing as being small.

extras.name: Switzerland
extras.fact: Famously small-feeling, but larger in area than every country on this round's actual list.

extras.name: Estonia
extras.fact: The northernmost of the Baltic states, and still larger than anything in the true top ten.

extras.name: Slovakia
extras.fact: Split from the Czech Republic in the 'Velvet Divorce' of 1993.

extras.name: Iceland
extras.fact: Often assumed to be tiny — it's actually larger in area than Ireland.
